props.name: modelValue
props.description: Ordered widget keys. Defaults to ['a','b','c','d']. Dragging swaps two keys (and their slot contents) in this list.

props.name: widgets
props.description: Optional metadata for tiles (title); missing keys fall back to modelValue order

events.name: change
events.description: Fired after a successful slot swap

events.name: swap
events.payload: payload: { from: CardWidgetKey; to: CardWidgetKey; order: CardWidgetKey[] }
events.description: Fired after a successful swap with from/to detail

events.name: dragEnd
events.payload: payload: { order: CardWidgetKey[] swapped: boolean from?: CardWidgetKey to?: CardWidgetKey }
events.description: Fired when a drag gesture ends (drop or cancel). Use for toast / analytics; prefer `change` for persistence.
